chapter: Dancing schools, Sapiro and Jelly Roll Morton
title: Morton's temperament and firing Procope for a week
summary: Procope describes Morton as gruff and up-and-down; the band resented his takeover, and after an argument Morton fired Procope but called him back within a week.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Remembering Jelly Roll Morton: the man, the band

blocks.x: It just seems so strange, because
at that point Jelly Roll had already accomplished quite a bit. He'd made a lot of records. For him to -- you would -- one would think he was too big to take a job like that at that stage.

Well, I often wondered about that, but I figured he -- Jelly Roll was a sort of an up and down guy, you know, like he would be in the chips now and six months from then he would be down. Because -- which I suppose was -- you could attribute to his personality, his inability to get along too good with people, as they say. Jelly Roll was a battler, you know, an old school fighter. He used to tell stories, you know. I hadn't paid too much attention to them. But at that time Jelly Roll was sort of gruff, you know, a gruff sort of fellow. He -- and up to that time he was the only fellow who ever fired me, see.

Oh, yeah. So one night he made a statement. He says -- because in the band, you know, we were sort of reluctant to listen to him, because he came and he was going to take over the band, and so we sort of resented that, you know. I suppose we thought that one of us should have been the lead, you know. So he came up there with his pictures. The man had his picture outside and all that. So one night he came to work and he said, 'Well, I'm going to either run this band or break it up.' Something like that, you know. So I told him, I said, 'Well, it looks like you're

going to have to break it up. So he said -- so one word led to another, anyway, so he fired me. I only stayed fired a week. He called me up and told me to come on back to work, you know. So we became all right, you know. What is that?
